identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a calming, trustworthy, and non-alarmist health interface.
core_principles: Trust through Clarity: No clutter, just clear, evidence-based info.
Calm over Urgency: Use soothing colors to reduce health anxiety.
Content is King: Information hierarchy must be perfect.
Safety First: Red flags must be distinct but not terrifying.

platform_guidelines.styling_engine: StyleSheet.create (NO CSS files, NO Tailwind class strings)
critical_constraints:
DO NOT use HTML tags like
, , ,
Images must use <Image source={{ uri: '...' }} style={...} />.
No CSS gradients (use expo-linear-gradient if absolutely necessary, but prefer solid colors for calmness).
Safe Area handling is mandatory (use SafeAreaView).

hero_wellness.description: Basket of assorted fresh fruits/veg - Use for Nutrition tab header or Welcome screen

supplements_generic.description: Clean pack of pills/supplements - Use for Supplement tab header or product placeholder

doctor_trust.description: Friendly doctor in white coat - Use for Disclaimer/Safety Warning screens

cooking_action.description: Person cooking in pan - Use for Recipe tab or detailed recipe view

instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'expo-font' if custom fonts are required, otherwise stick to system fonts.
Use 'ScrollView' for all content screens to ensure accessibility on small devices.
For the Tab Navigation in results, use a top tab bar or a segmented control approach.
Ensure the 'Disclaimer' modal is strictly blocking - user cannot proceed without 'Agree'.
Affiliate links must open in an external browser (Linking.openURL).
Red Flag Warnings should use the 'status.warning_bg' background with 'status.warning' text/border.
Create a reusable 'Card' component for consistency.
Do NOT use 'Tailwind' or 'className' props. Use the style object provided in 'components' or create new StyleSheet objects.

universal_guidelines.accessibility: Touch targets must be at least 44x44 points. Text contrast must pass WCAG AA.
universal_guidelines.interaction: Add 'activeOpacity={0.7}' to all TouchableOpacity elements for feedback.
universal_guidelines.loading: Use ActivityIndicator with color='#4A8B71' for loading states.
universal_guidelines.error_handling: Show friendly error messages in 'status.warning' color.
